title: Faster deterministic arithmetic follow-ups
points: Follow-up questions that explicitly reuse prior figures can now compute simple sensitivities directly instead of re-querying the statement corpus.
Net-margin follow-ups such as increasing revenue while holding net profit unchanged now show the numerator, denominator, formula, and revised margin in a table-backed answer.
The regression eval now includes a conversation-history arithmetic case so this behavior is tested alongside routing and source-retrieval checks.
